# f2b1 pixel expectations (generated by pixels.py; x1 320x240, clear (100,149,237), glyph rectangles of the f2b0 annex)

Classes: ink = one of the 14 opaque colours of font3.png (most texels (41,49,16)); frame = one of the 7 frame colours or 4 cursor colours (the three sets are disjoint); bg = the clear colour (a transparent frame texel shows it).

### Scroll, ending pass 100 (offset 16)

Row 0 band is wiped; rows 1 and 2 sit where they will sit after the shift.

| (x, y) | expected RGBA | class | why |
|---|---|---|---|
| (33, 172) | (184, 176, 144, 255) | frame | old row 0 ("gypjq") pixel row 15 lands at y 172 (the clip top). The CPU draw list holds ink there ((41, 49, 16, 255)) but the ClearImage of that band runs before DrawOTag (hypothesis H1): frame colour (184, 176, 144, 255) |
| (36, 175) | (41, 49, 16, 255) | ink | old row 1 ("deux", y 168 + 5 + 16 - 16 = 173) pixel row 2: ink, the same texel as the next pass (offset 0) |
| (49, 191) | (41, 49, 16, 255) | ink | old row 2 ("trois", y 189) pixel row 2 |

Check: the ending-pass visible image is identical to the next pass image (offset 0, shifted bands): True. The CPU-draw-list image differs from it in 14 pixels, all on y = 172.
